content.title: Validate frontend e2e test stability
content.description:
Validate that the two previously-flaky frontend e2e tests are now stable after the dev fixes, and that nothing regressed.

(1) phase3 parent-selector 'changes an existing parent' (phase3-validation.spec.ts ~line 1287) — previously intermittent waitForResponse timeout.
(2) phase4 copy-token 'copy button changes to check icon after register' (phase4-validation.spec.ts ~line 748) — previously intermittent clipboard/check-icon failure.

Approach: run the full serial e2e suite multiple times; both target tests must pass reliably with no intermittent waitForResponse timeouts and no clipboard/check-icon failures. Confirm no regressions in the surrounding describe blocks. Both flake sites are distinct from the backend shared-state fix in mqe0745gy7 (workers:1 serialization), which must remain in place. If flakes persist, report the specific failure mode so the developer can iterate.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqe1uwxw8c transitioned to done

content.content:
Validation complete. The two previously-flaky tests are now STABLE.

Target test 1 - phase3 'changes an existing parent' (parent-selector): passed 3 of 3 in isolation plus passed in a clean full-suite run. The dev fix is correct (waitForResponse is now registered BEFORE the fill that triggers the search, with a matcher scoped via URLSearchParams to the exact search term, so it cannot latch onto stale or debounced responses).

Target test 2 - phase4 'copy button changes to check icon after register' (copy-token): passed 3 of 3 in isolation plus passed in a clean full-suite run. The dev fix is correct (clipboard-read and clipboard-write permissions granted for that test so navigator.clipboard.writeText does not throw under headless Chromium and abort the handler before tokenCopied state is set).

No regressions caused by this dev fix. The fix is committed and fully local to those two tests, so it cannot affect other areas.

IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENT CAVEAT for the PM:
- A first full-suite run showed 38 failures, but that run was corrupted by CONCURRENT agent activity (another agent was running e2e against the shared validation e2edata store AND editing packages/library files mid-run, which made the bun watch dev server reload mid-test). After that activity stopped, a clean full-suite run showed only 8 failures.
- Those 8 remaining failures are all in frontend list, navigation, and tree tests (phase2 filtering, create-dialog, list-to-detail navigation; phase3 tree-view expand plus 'sets a parent') and are caused by large UNCOMMITTED WIP in the frontend (IssueList.tsx, IssuesPage.tsx, IssueFilters.tsx, IssueTree.tsx, use-issues.ts, new use-issue-filters.ts), NOT by this dev fix. They manifest as the issues list rendering 'No issues yet'.
- I could not produce a definitive clean-HEAD baseline because agt init (used by the e2e global-setup) cannot create the e2edata worktree inside a nested git worktree. Attribution is therefore analytical rather than A-vs-B, but it is strong: every failing test depends on the WIP-modified components, and all backend and non-WIP tests passed.

Net: the assigned flake-stability validation SUCCEEDS. The broader suite's 8 failures are pre-existing or in-flight frontend WIP and should be re-validated once that WIP lands. Will file a separate idea for a related anti-pattern found in a sibling test.
